items.title: Fed holds rates steady, signals patience on next move
items.snippet: The Federal Reserve kept its benchmark rate at 3.50-3.75%, noting that inflation progress has stalled while the labor market remains resilient, suggesting cuts are unlikely before late 2026.

items.title: US tightens chip export controls to China, targeting AI accelerators
items.snippet: New Commerce Department rules restrict the export of advanced AI chips to China, directly impacting Nvidia's data center revenue from the region and forcing the company to develop compliant alternatives.

items.title: Strong dollar headwind builds for US tech multinationals
items.snippet: The broad trade-weighted dollar index near 120 is creating translation headwinds for companies with significant international revenue, though semiconductor firms with dollar-denominated contracts are partially insulated.
